item.text: The campaign is ready with two approved posts, $250 lifetime caps per ad group, and an initial combined pace of $62.50 per day. Both groups target engine-related keywords in the US and Canada and end at midnight Eastern after November 28. I’ll activate them now and check delivery later today.
Both ads are delivering. The first check shows $20.94 spent, 10,903 impressions and 6 link clicks. That’s too few clicks to choose a winner, so I’ll keep the split for another day.

Post 2 has an early cost advantage: $2.88 per link click versus $4.42 for Post 1. I’ve shifted more budget toward Post 2 while keeping Post 1 running for comparison. The combined lifetime cap remains $500.
The campaign has spent $148.61 for 88,881 impressions and 46 link clicks. Post 2 is holding its advantage at $2.86 per click versus $4.16 for Post 1, so I’ll keep the current allocation.

Post 2 now costs about 32% less per link click. I’ve increased its share to $400 of the lifetime budget and raised its daily allowance to address slower spending. Post 1 has the remaining $100 cap; the shared limit stays $500.

Spend is now $259.86, with 161,160 impressions and 83 link clicks. Post 2 continues to produce cheaper clicks, and the increased allowance has improved spending pace. I’ll keep the allocation and check again tomorrow.
The latest totals are $337.73 spent, 194,353 impressions and 107 link clicks. Post 2 remains more efficient at $2.96 per click versus $4.06 for Post 1. Both groups remain within their caps.

As of Black Friday midday, spend is $419.10 for 227,687 impressions and 138 link clicks. I’ve lowered Post 2’s daily allowance to spread its remaining budget through Saturday. The scheduled stop remains midnight Eastern after November 28.

item.text: On the final day, reported spend is $462.32 for 251,484 impressions and 157 link clicks. I’ve raised Post 2’s daily allowance so it can use its remaining lifetime budget before tonight’s stop. The combined $500 cap is unchanged.
The campaign has reached its scheduled end and is paused. I’ll check the reported totals once more in an hour before sending the recap.

The campaign wrapped up on November 28 Eastern time and is paused.

- **Spend:** $496.89 of $500
- **Impressions:** 272,104
- **Link clicks:** 173
- **Average cost per link click:** $2.87

I promoted two approved posts to US and Canadian audiences, shifting budget toward Post 2 as it delivered cheaper clicks.

Sign-ups couldn’t be measured through X because the site has no pixel. These are X’s reported delivery totals.
